en-US.description:
IFCDC Barbers makes it easy to book professional barbershop appointments. Browse real haircut and style photos, choose your service, pick a barber and time, and pay securely with PayPal.

Features:
• Book appointments with live availability
• View service photos and style gallery before you book
• Secure PayPal checkout and email confirmations
• AURA assistant for quick booking help
• Manage your profile and booking history

Official app for IFCDC Barbers — smart booking powered by real style photos.

en-US.releaseNotes: Version 1.1 — Super Admin platform management: global Shops & Locations, barber approval and management actions, monetization and access controls (bookings, payments, subscriptions, platform fees), and full sync with the live production backend. Includes performance improvements and bug fixes from Builds 37–39.

review.notes:
APP REVIEW NOTES — Build 39 (Version 1.1)

Review Account:
Email: apple.review@ifcdcbarbersapp.com
Password: IFCDC-Review2026!

What's new in 1.1:
Super Admin users (platform owner) can open Admin → Shop management for global Shops & Locations, pending shop approvals, and per-shop monetization/access toggles. Admin → Barber management supports approve, suspend, edit, assign shop, and subscription tier updates. All admin features use the live production API with Bearer authentication.

How to test admin (optional):
Sign in with the review account above if configured as platform admin, or use apple.review@ifcdcbarbersapp.com after we enable admin role for review.

Customer booking flow (required):
Home → Book → select barber → service → time → PayPal checkout.

Account Deletion:
Profile → Delete Account → Type DELETE → Confirm
